medals.name: "Awaken"
medals.desc: You have returned to Talos-II.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Prologue - Process: Awakening

medals.name: "Core ex Machina"
medals.desc: The future of frontier development has descended upon Valley IV.
medals.cond: Summon the fruit of a great technological endeavor

medals.name: "The Fist Misses"
medals.desc:
You have defeated the "Bonekrushing Fist".
Embrace the Æther and usher in a new future? What is your opinion about Nefarith's speech?
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter I Process I: Fort Showdown

medals.name: "The Refugees Strike Back?!"
medals.desc:
You witnessed an unexpected "explosion".
The Power Plant is apparently not as defensible as it seems.
medals.cond: Witness an attack in progress

medals.name: "Shards of the Crushed Star"
medals.desc: You have defeated a partially revived Aggelos of massive proportions.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter I Process III: Cradle of the Ages

medals.name: "Rift Sealing"
medals.desc: You and your team fought hard and sealed the rift that was about to devour the entirety of Valley IV.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Undying Cinders

medals.name: "Returning Signs of Ill Omen"
medals.desc: Foreboding signs have appeared throughout Talos-II. Your journey is not yet complete.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Intermission: Conference of the Four

medals.name: "First Visit to Wuling"
medals.desc: You have reached Wuling City.
medals.cond: Reach an all-new city

medals.name: "Drowning in Water"
medals.desc:
A promise and a choice.
The old way sank beneath pristine ripples, but where is the new path for these people?
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅲ: No Retreat

medals.name: "The Final Lord I Served"
medals.desc: Ardashir looks at you. He sees what you cannot, visions that you have forgotten.
medals.cond: Part ways with Ardashir at a certain key location

medals.name: "Conqueror's Fall"
medals.desc: She is a conqueror whose heart was ignited by ambition, who seeks to sacrifice tens of thousands for a glimpse into the forbidden realm. You have crushed the malice of Nefarith.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅴ: Battle of the Main Pillar

medals.name: "Gently Down the Stream"
medals.desc: Zhuang Fangyi waited, and you finally arrived.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅵ: Forged at the Very Beginning

medals.name: "A Seal Lifted"
medals.desc: You are prepared to stare down oblivion in its face. Though sealed away for many years, it is still the very manifestation of despair.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Bravely Breach the Hostile Winds

medals.name: "A Dialog of Swords"
medals.desc: He has understood. The living devote their commitment to their blades.
medals.cond: Bid farewell to an instructor of Tanjian Hall

medals.name: "Connection to the Past"
medals.desc: A Xiranite bridge now links the present to the past. The road is now open to you.
medals.cond: Span the chasm with a Xiranite bridge

medals.name: "Child of Hope"
medals.desc: Gently her heart was kept afloat through the overlapping mire of death ... to the place where hope will sprout and grow.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Warily Returns the Wandering Vigile

medals.name: "Thus Ends the Weeping Gash"
medals.desc: The weeping gash will no longer bring pain.
medals.cond: Complete the main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Homecoming

medals.name: "Enter the Painted World"
medals.desc: They saw the beautiful painting, and made their way deeper into the mountain.
medals.cond: Complete main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅷ: Inn the Painting

medals.name: "See Through the Self"
medals.desc: To elucidate my obsession, and heal my deepest ills.
medals.cond: Complete main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅷ: Trial Ⅲ - A Path Where There's None

medals.name: "Paint with Fresh Ink"
medals.desc: Water down the old ink splotches, and more brilliant strokes can be made to make the painting anew.
medals.cond: Complete main mission Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅷ: The Conclusion

medals.name: True Altruist
medals.desc: You helped plenty of people with their problems.
medals.cond: Complete 30 exploration missions

reforge.desc:
You helped plenty of people with their problems.
Not all of them involved combat, and your goal transcends monetary pay.

You helped plenty of people with their problems.
Those who benefited from your assistance will help others in return. The people of Talos-II must learn to support one another.

medals.name: "Lone Wolf"
medals.desc:
Wulfgard found the truth and executed the traitor.
He plunged that dagger in the earth before the grave... The Pack had changed. He knew what he had to do.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: Lone Wolf

medals.name: "Letter From a Messenger"
medals.desc:
A few tiny errands, a few packages to deliver.
You met her under the sunset skies. Beautiful memories and moments shall be the gifts that fill her empty letter.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: Letter from a Messenger

medals.name: "Love, Scream & The Prototype"
medals.desc:
A crate of pigments had arrived late.
You followed Tata's trail and created various graffiti. In these colors, Yvonne saw the potential of reunion.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: Love, Scream & The Prototype

medals.name: "Let Fire Consume the Ashen Past"
medals.desc:
The scars of memories may change in the fire.
Though fragments of the past have built up like imposing mountains, you took Laevatain's hand and left the unending corridor.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: Let Fire Consume the Ashen Past

medals.name: "The Red Knight"
medals.desc:
When they arrived at the children's realm, the travelers stopped to rest their feet.
Who can remember the scraping of knees from forgotten seasons of childhood?
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: The Red Knight

medals.name: "A Fistful of Reflections"
medals.desc: Their fists question my resolve, but my Qi punches through the lands and challenges the very thunder itself.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: A Fistful of Reflections

medals.name: "Danse Macabre"
medals.desc: The chase, the fresh scent of blood, and an old wound that still throbs with pain... Camille has sworn that his blood will forever be with the Endministrator.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: Danse Macabre

medals.name: "Like a Star Streaking Through the Boundaries"
medals.desc: Endfield Industries is finally getting its very own celebrity brand idol... We gotta start the rehearsals, performances, and... Oh dear. There are just so many things to do.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission Like a Star Streaking Through the Boundaries

medals.name: "A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods"
medals.desc: You followed the seeking gaze, tracked down the guiding arrow, weathered the frigid winds through mist and dreams ... and heard Her echoes in the Snowy Forest.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission: A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods

medals.name: "Fate Beneath the Snow"
medals.desc: A Snowpriestess left her writings and resolution ... and let the snow bury her destiny. Yet a soft, determined girl brushed it aside, and revealed her final fate.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission Illumination of Fate and Endeavor of a Lifetime

medals.name: "Let Suiming Light the Way"
medals.desc: The bell strikes again, my heart pursues illumination once more.
medals.cond: Complete the side mission Bell of Recollection

medals.name: "A Day to Remember"
medals.desc: Truly wonderful. A fowlbeast who composes poetry, and a smoky stove that tugs at our hearts.
medals.cond: Complete side mission A Day to Remember

medals.name: Combined Arms
medals.desc: Your operators are fully trained to unleash combos on the enemy.
medals.cond: Perform 500 combos during combat

reforge.desc: Your operators are fully trained. They will exploit opportunities and unleash combos during combat.

Your operators are fully trained, and they fight primarily as a concerted team with combos.
Mutual trust is what we depend on to reach our destination.

medals.name: Arts and Flow
medals.desc: Thus flow the Originium Arts.
medals.cond: Apply 50 during combat

reforge.desc: Your enemies now fear your proficiency in energy manipulation.
You are the undisputed maestro of the Originium Arts.

medals.name: Superb Physicals
medals.desc: You have demonstrated your combat techniques.
medals.cond: Apply 50 during combat

reforge.desc: Your enemies now fear your powerful slashes and fists.
You are the undisputed master of combat.

medals.name: "Crushed the Bony Fist"
medals.desc: In the illusions of the Protocol Space, you ended his path of violence, fanaticism, and fury.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Pandemonium: Rhodagn
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Pandemonium: Rhodagn in 120s

medals.name: "Broken Remains of Astarron"
medals.desc: In the illusions of the Protocol Space, you stopped the Astarron of destruction from ever returning to the land.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Calamity: Triaggelos
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Calamity: Triaggelos in 240s

medals.name: "Collapse of Her Pale Image"
medals.desc: In the illusions of the Protocol Space, once again you defeated the great effigy of pale marble.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Calamity: Marble Aggelomoirai
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Calamity: Marble Aggelomoirai in 240s

medals.name: Master Interceptor
medals.desc: You are an expert in intercepting enemy attacks.
medals.cond: Interrupt the enemies' charging states 30 times during combat

reforge.desc: You now interrupt enemies just when they're about to do something more aggressive.
reforge.cond: Interrupt the enemies' charging states 50 times during combat

reforge.desc: You can now detect even the most minute hint of aggression, and interrupt any acts of belligerence, no matter how subtle.
reforge.cond: Interrupt the enemies' charging states 100 times during combat

medals.name: Ultimate Immobilizer
medals.desc: Your combat techniques are breathtaking. You can unleash total and complete domination of the enemy.
medals.cond: Immobilize the same enemy continuously for 20s during combat

medals.name: Total Obliterator
medals.desc: We have cause to believe that one day will come when you can eliminate enemies with your gaze.
medals.cond: Defeat at least 5 enemies with a single damaging hit

medals.name: Smart Annihilation
medals.desc: Your combat facilities have demonstrated their capabilities.
medals.cond: Defeat 10 enemies with combat facilities

reforge.desc: Your combat facilities are steadily beating back the enemy.
With such efficient engines of war, there is almost no need for you to expose yourself to danger.

medals.name: "Thus Withers the Branch of Fury"
medals.desc: The rainy night ignited his fire of fury, and it finally withered away amidst the phantoms of the Protocol Space.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Calamity: Ruan Yi
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Calamity: Ruan Yi in 200s

medals.name: "NO MORE KIDNAPPING!"
medals.desc: Cangzei pirates and river brigands are known for holding people hostage for ransom. Obviously, you did not let them get their way.
medals.cond: Rescue a teammate trapped by Nimbus Razor 1 time

medals.name: "Entropic Reduction"
medals.desc: The frigid cold slowed you down to keep you close.
medals.cond: Have any operators becoming during battle 10 times

medals.name: "Conqueror's Grief"
medals.desc: Her insane ambition and disdainful laughter finally dissipated in the phantoms of the Protocol Space.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Calamity: Nefarith
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Calamity: Nefarith in 200s

medals.name: "Silencing the Drum"
medals.desc: You broke the feral banner and silenced the deafening drum.
medals.cond: Defeat the Skydrummer

medals.name: "Interceptor of Thunder"
medals.desc: You successfully grabbed the thunderous peal by its throat.
medals.cond: Interrupt the Skydrummer's roaring shockwave during combat

medals.name: "Unstable Æthillu"
medals.desc: You saw through the Æthillu and dispelled the unstable material.
medals.cond: During battle, defeat an "Æthillu" within 2s of its revival

medals.name: "Mega-Beast Subdued"
medals.desc: You subdued the lord of the beasts. Perhaps you can be their new lord?
medals.cond: Defeat the Craghowler

medals.name: "Gale Weaver"
medals.desc: You faced a storm of heavy blows, each capable of rending mortal flesh to pieces, and you came out unscathed with great agility.
medals.cond: The controlled operator suffers zero DMG and performs at least 5 perfect dodges against the spinning attack of the Armored Manglerbeast

medals.name: "Blitzcrash's Silent Passing"
medals.desc: Its roaring grows increasingly soft and silent, like when it was but a little cub.
medals.cond: Defeat the Blitzcrash Blightshade

medals.name: "A Torch Extinguished"
medals.desc: In the phantasm of the Protocol Space, the returned cited a vision and tried to extend an invitation. In the end, the fiery light he gave off was also snuffed out softly.
medals.cond: Complete Crisis Calamity: Alleikhreos, Chiliarch
medals.trim: Complete Crisis Calamity: Alleikhreos, Chiliarch in 200s

medals.name: "Gloomwald's Silence"
medals.desc: You extinguished the rage of Gloomwald. The loyal creations neither hate nor seethe, allowing peace to return to this land.
medals.cond: Defeat the Gloomwald's Rage

medals.name: "Completely Uprooted"
medals.desc: You struck early and uprooted the woodcraft from the earth... The wild and rampant roots and tubers have a habit of causing trouble.
medals.cond: Force burrowing Woodcraft Wanderers to resurface

medals.name: "Art of Blanks"
medals.desc: Know where to leave blanks, where to keep the inked strokes, and when to give way to prepare for an advance.
medals.cond: Let Si unleash her Painting ATK during the black-and-white state of Inkwashed Realm, and do not let the controlled operator take any DMG from the Painting ATK.

medals.name: "Insight of Rejuvenation"
medals.desc: Where the material world ends in the illusory realm of the Protocol Space, there waits an elegant figure with a magic brush. And you, a soul with an enlightened mind, know it is time for rejuvenation.
medals.cond: Complete "Crisis Calamity: Si"
medals.trim: Complete "Crisis Calamity: Si" in 200s

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Searing Scars" stages at Agony mode

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Turbidity Manifest" stages at Agony mode

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Contention of Deathly Silences" stages at Agony mode

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Howlers of the Crag" stages at Agony mode

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Marked by Dark Shadows" stages at Agony mode

medals.trim: In Umbral Monument, complete all "Murmurs of the Deep Forest" stages at Agony mode
